acceptance_criteria: engineering_team.py lists every objective with the stated fields and correct totals, and --json matches the text
a test shows two objectives with distinct attempts, one blocked with its blocker, and correct free slots
a test proves the script writes nothing (store and runtime directory byte-identical before and after)
prohibited_actions: deploy, promote to production, restart services or change systemd/launchd/watchers
read, add or change secrets, credentials or tokens
Shopify, Gmail, Stripe or any other business write, or any external send
change reviewer principals, owner authority, permissions or connector/MCP access
destructive repository cleanup or history rewriting
change the frozen engineering lifecycle kernel
requested_outcome: Make concurrent multi-objective operation a real operating path the owner can watch. Add a new read-only script crooks-assistant/scripts/engineering_team.py taking the same --store/--repo/--registry/--runtime-root/--workspace-root/--max-concurrent arguments as scripts/engineering_dispatcher.py (build the Dispatcher the same way, importing from app.orchestrator; do not modify engineering_dispatcher.py). It prints one line per objective (objective id, stage, current attempt id, builder kind, live builder pids, reviewer principal and mechanism when reviewing, blocker when blocked), then totals (building, reviewing, blocked, complete, other) and --max-concurrent with how many builder slots are free; --json prints the same as one JSON object. It must never tick, launch, write a record or change a file: it only reads Dispatcher.status() and the store. Test it in a new tests/test_engineering_team.py using the World helper from tests/test_engineering_dispatcher.py (import it the way tests/test_gpt_reviewer.py does).
title: Engineering Team Activation V1
